intended_action.name: 绕掌系 X 轴定向旋转

hands.view: palm up, fingers strongly foreshortened toward viewer

thumb.trace: Panel 1: image-left thumb leaves the radial palm, opens diagonally upward-left and ends in a rounded pad with a lateral nail, across one main thumb bend.

index.trace: Panel 1: first visible central ray beside the thumb rises toward the viewer from the distal palm to the leftmost front-facing nail; provisionally index from base order.

middle.trace: Panel 1: middle visible central ray has its own knuckle/folded chain and the central nail-bearing tip in front of the cube.

ring.trace: Panel 1: third central ray to image-right has a separate shorter foreshortened chain and rightmost front-facing nail, provisionally ring from base order.

little.trace: Panel 1: folds on the outer right palm rim could conceal a tightly folded ulnar ray, but no independent base-to-tip little-finger path can be distinguished.

hands.count_observation: Thumb and three front-facing finger chains are individually resolved. A fifth ray is neither confirmed nor asserted absent solely from the ulnar rim folds.
hands.length_observation: The three front-facing curled fingers are strongly foreshortened and their visible centerlines are broadly comparable, with the rightmost smaller. The thumb has plausible two-section length. Little-finger length and the full ordering of all four finger lengths remain unknown; palm creases do not supply the missing measurement.
hands.joint_observation: The three visible central fingers join the distal palm continuously and their nails face the viewer in the curled pose. Ulnar-side folds do not resolve a fourth phalangeal chain. Wrist and short forearm are complete.
